answer: Rewards vest linearly over 40 epochs in escrow, and any identity later flagged as a duplicate forfeits its unvested balance. A farm of n accounts must therefore float n times the average vesting balance before seeing profit, tying up capital that grows with every extra head. Waiting on a ridge of locked earnings, an honest member loses little; a kernel of forged accounts cannot forge its way out, since forge speed does not shorten vesting.
